title: Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay Order Limits by Product
content:
Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay sets four order limits for each product. They are applied to one customer's orders of one product at a time.

| Product | Orders to one destination in a rolling 24 hours | Orders per customer in a rolling 30 calendar days | Order value per customer in a rolling 30 calendar days (USD) | Duplicate window (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Airtime Top-Up | 5 | 60 | $500.00 | 1 |
| Paloma Data Bundle | 5 | 60 | $500.00 | 1 |
| Paloma Electricity Token | 3 | 20 | $1000.00 | 2 |
| Paloma Bill Pay Utilities | 2 | 20 | $3000.00 | 24 |
| Paloma Bill Pay Television | 2 | 10 | $600.00 | 24 |
| Paloma Bill Pay School Fees | 2 | 10 | $10000.00 | 24 |

## What each column states

- **Orders to one destination in a rolling 24 hours** is the most orders of the product to one phone number, meter number or biller account in any 24 hours.
- **Orders per customer in a rolling 30 calendar days** is the most orders of the product one customer may hold in 30 calendar days.
- **Order value per customer in a rolling 30 calendar days** is the most order value, in US dollars, of the product one customer may hold in 30 calendar days.
- **Duplicate window** is the number of hours within which a second order of the same product, destination and value is treated as a duplicate and not placed.

## Comparisons within the table

- The limits are per product: a customer's Paloma Airtime Top-Up orders do not count against the customer's Paloma Data Bundle limits, even though the two products share the same figures.
- Paloma Bill Pay Television and Paloma Bill Pay School Fees share the 10-order monthly count, but their value limits differ: $600.00 for Paloma Bill Pay Television and $10000.00 for Paloma Bill Pay School Fees.
- The three bill products share a 24-hour duplicate window and a limit of 2 orders to one biller account in 24 hours.
